content: G0=rapid/non-cutting linear move, G1=linear feed move, G2/G3=clockwise/counter-clockwise arc moves defined by end point (X Y Z) plus center offset (I J[K]) or radius (R). Edge cases: at least one of I/J required with center-offset form; omitting X/Y with I/J does a full circle; mixing I/J with R is invalid; omitting X/Y and using R is invalid. G-code dialects differ meaningfully across vendors: RepRap/Marlin (3D printers), LinuxCNC/Grbl (mills/routers), Fanuc/Haas/Siemens/Mazak (industrial CNC) -- differ in modal state defaults, arc plane selection (G17/18/19), whether G0 honors feed limits, and comment/line-number syntax. A parser written against only one dialect will silently misinterpret files from another.
